title: Austin Land Deals: Convention & Arts Future
summary:
*   Austin officials held a special meeting to discuss crucial land acquisitions.
*   A primary focus was securing property for future Convention Center parking.
*   Discussions also centered on acquiring land for a Downtown Arts Project.
*   The meeting was held in executive session, with no final decisions or votes taken.
